# `paper/figures/`

**What it is.** Figure assets of the article.

**Purpose in the repository.** The five figures embedded in `ARWLF_Naman_PM.docx` (topology, pipeline, crossover, dense, target) as PNG and vector files, with `figures.json` describing them. Generated by `paper/build_results.py` from `paper/data/`.

**Files directly in this folder:** 11 (besides this README).  
Repository-wide status of every file: [`LEGACY_MAP.md`](../../LEGACY_MAP.md).
